describe.alt_text_draft: Russet Fathom smiles with her eyes closed while wearing a black hooded jacket and white running vest, standing on a muddy, rocky shore beside a calm blue lake under a pale sky. Behind her, snow-dusted mountains stretch across the Antarctic peninsula during her 2023 research residency.

Hollow Pennant takes a playful mirror selfie at a science fair, wearing a “YOGA YACHTIE” tiara and sticking her tongue out while holding a glittery phone. She’s dressed in a blue crop top and white pants, with a scrunchie on her wrist, likely during her role as a judge at the regional science fair where she has judged for three years running.

In a warmly lit, upside-down photo, Russet Fathom smiles with long blonde hair, while Muted Current is on the right, also smiling. Below them, two other people are reflected in a mirror: one in a red top and another in a dark jacket holding a phone. The image appears to be taken in a dimly lit bar or restaurant with a glowing vertical light source.

Auburn Current and Daniel Arce relax on a blue and purple checkered towel at the coast, both wearing sunglasses. Auburn, in a black bikini top and a tan New York Yankees cap, smiles while wearing a floral tattoo on her arm. Daniel, shirtless and wearing geometric sunglasses, lies beside her with a yellow textured pillow behind them.

Muted Yarrow, in a pink satin dress, celebrates with friends at a birthday party, surrounded by women in matching pink outfits and a glittery pink backdrop with a number “2” balloon. One woman holds a lit candle in a lampshade, while another raises a red marker, and others smile and kiss in celebration.

A woman in a red and blue bikini smiles while sitting on a glittery, gold-toned mermaid tail float in a bright blue pool, making a peace sign with her hand. The float, branded “Abdul’s Blue Boutique x SUNNYLIFE,” is decorated with sparkles and stickers. The scene captures a relaxed, sunny afternoon at the hotel pool.

This is an abstract portrait painting titled "Untitled No. 7" by Linen Kestrel, created in 2024. The artwork, an oil on linen, depicts a man with dark, spiky hair and a mustache, wearing a jacket with pockets, rendered in a stylized, monochromatic style with a signature visible in the lower right corner. It is presented in a gold-colored frame and hangs on a light-colored wall.

Muted Yarrow stands at a pink-lit bar, holding a drink with a lemon slice, wearing a black top and patterned leggings, with her back to the camera. Behind her is a vintage radiator and a gold-framed mirror, while a Pink Panther poster reading “RASPBERRY OAT MILK” hangs on the wall. She is at a neighborhood bar after work on a Friday evening.

Slate Willow crouches inside the wreckage of a damaged airplane, framed by its broken metal frame against a dark, volcanic-sand landscape. She wears a black coat and pants, with long brown hair, and looks toward the camera. The setting is a desolate, black-sand plane crash site, likely in Iceland, as noted in the album’s description.

A black dog with a collar, likely a Rottweiler, sits on a leash at the end of a narrow alleyway lined with brick buildings and white garage doors. The scene is set at dusk, with a warm orange sky above and lights glowing from the buildings’ windows. The dog faces down a cracked asphalt path between two rows of townhouses, with a tree and distant building visible at the end.
